{{Quote|I'm Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo of the Chiss Ascendancy. This is the ''Springhawk'', Picket Force Two command vessel of the Expansionary Defense Fleet.|Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
The '''''Springhawk''''' was a [[Cruiser/Legends|Chiss assault cruiser]] serving with [[Picket Force Two/Legends|Picket Force Two]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]'s [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Expansionary Fleet]]. It served as the personal [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrawn".

==Description==
===Armament===
Armed with missile batteries and the typical blue-beamed [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[maser]]s, the ship packed a powerful punch for a ship of her size. The missile launchers could also be used to deploy large [[Conner net|shock nets]], which could disable target vessels. A precisely-tuned [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] enabled her to make tactical microjumps, and a powerful communications array allowed her to deploy electronic warfare techniques that could confound far more heavily-armed enemies. Commander Thrawn utilized its full power against the Vagaari, including acquiring a [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity-well projector]] during the [[battle of Geroon]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

===Design and construction===
Although little bigger than<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> a 115 [[Meter/Legends|meter]]<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|Republic cruiser]], the ''Springhawk'' was nevertheless the command ship for the Expansionary Fleet in the area of frontier space around [[Crustai]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

The [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''Springhawk'' featured navigation and [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] stations, various displays and status boards, with a command chair in the center. An armory was located below the bridge with a stash of armored Chiss [[combat suit]]s with self-sealant capabilities. A small and simple room, that was referred to as conference room or duty crew meal room by the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]] was located inside the ship. Its furnishings consisted of a table and half a dozen chairs. Five [[Meter/Legends|meters]] down the corridor from the conference room, a resting area with personal quarters was located.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

Aside from the bridge and the armory, there were several crewed [[forward visual triangulation site]]s on the ship in order to track enemy vessels and coordinate the firing of weaponry during combat, which included the [[Forward Visual Triangulation Site Number One]]. The efforts of these Chiss warriors augmented the ship's existing sensor systems, and sometimes provided a more reliable description of a battle.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Springhawk'' first appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']].<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> The [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' includes an [[:File:Outbound_Flight.jpg|illustration]] by [[Chris Trevas]] of the scene from ''Outbound Flight'' in which [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]] is beside Mitth'raw'nuruodo as the latter is being [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] choked by [[Jorus C'baoth]]. The setting of the illustration is the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> of a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Trade Federation battleship]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> Although Mitth'raw'nuruodo and Doriana both do visit the bridge of such a [[Battleship/Legends|vessel]] during the events of ''Outbound Flight'', during the aforementioned scene the pair is aboard the bridge of the ''Springhawk'' instead.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
